name: WNC AI MCP
changelog: Fix site_health tool (load update.php so get_core_updates exists; guard each test). Add OAuth discovery self-check exposed as oauth_discovery_ok on /health plus a host-agnostic admin notice. Auto-add an Apache/LiteSpeed .htaccess rule that routes site-root /.well-known/oauth-* to the /wp-json/ routes so the one-click connector works on shared hosts (marker-wrapped, above the WordPress block, rolled back on 5xx, skipped on nginx). Daily prune of stale OAuth client registrations.
